query:
SELECT TO_CHAR(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "name!",
                           COALESCE(SUM(num), 0)::float8 AS "value!"
                      FROM bot_posts_by_team_day
                     WHERE day >= $1 AND day <= $2
                     GROUP BY 1
                     ORDER BY 1 DESC
                     LIMIT 30
